INSERT INTO crm_mapper_versions (
            provider,
            object_api_name,
            version,
            mapper_name,
            mapper_contract,
            is_active,
            deprecated_at
         )
         VALUES ($1::text::crm_provider, $2, $3, $4, $5::text::jsonb, $6, $7)
         ON CONFLICT (provider, object_api_name, version)
         DO UPDATE
            SET mapper_name = EXCLUDED.mapper_name,
                mapper_contract = EXCLUDED.mapper_contract,
                is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active,
                deprecated_at = EXCLUDED.deprecated_at
         RETURNING id
